source: PLACEHOLDER list assembled for the Day 5 frontend skeleton. Every number, URL and opening hour below must be re-verified by a person before this file is served to anyone in distress; that verification is part of the crisis-content milestone (see AGENTS.md safety rule 6).
disclaimer: These lines are free, confidential and staffed by trained people. Manovia is not a crisis service and cannot send help to you.

resources.name: 112 — European emergency number
resources.description: The emergency number across the European Union, free from any phone.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free, confidential support for people in distress, and for people worried about someone else.

resources.name: Samaritans
resources.description: A listening ear, any time, for anything that is getting on top of you.

resources.name: Tele-MANAS
resources.description: India's national mental-health helpline, in several languages.

resources.name: Lifeline Australia
resources.description: Crisis support and suicide prevention, for you or for someone you care about.

resources.name: 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline
resources.description: Canada's suicide crisis helpline, by call or text.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text HOME to 741741 to reach a trained crisis counsellor by message.

resources.name: Befrienders Worldwide
resources.description: A directory of emotional-support helplines in countries not listed here.
